title: Downhole structural measurement
description:
A structural observation at a depth in a hole — orientation relative to the core axis, and the feature observed.

GENERATED from the normative OpenAPI document (`spec/openapi.yaml`) — do not edit by hand; run `python scripts/regenerate.py`. The OpenAPI document is normative for the wire; this file is the same contract for one record type, readable on its own.

bhid.description: Natural key of the drill hole: `{"hole_id", "project", "company"}`.

depth_at.title: Depth at center of feature
depth_at.description: Depth of this measurement ALONG the hole from the collar, in `length_units` — not a vertical depth, and not a distance from surface once the hole deviates.

depth_from.description: Top of this interval, measured ALONG the hole from the collar, in `length_units`.

depth_to.description: Base of this interval, measured ALONG the hole from the collar, in `length_units`.

display_units.description: Units the *_display strings on this record are formatted in, from the project's display preference. Presentation only: the stored values remain in `length_units`.

xyz_at.description: Desurveyed position at `depth_at`, as `[x, y, z]` on the project local grid in metres. Null when the hole has no survey.

xyz_from.description: Desurveyed position at `depth_from`, as `[x, y, z]` on the PROJECT LOCAL GRID in metres — not WGS84, and not the record's own `epsg`. Null when the hole has no survey to desurvey against.

xyz_to.description: Desurveyed position at `depth_to`, as `[x, y, z]` on the project local grid in metres. Null when the hole has no survey.

beta.description: Rotation angle around core axis from reference line (0-360 degrees)

confidence.description:
Orientation measurement confidence

* `0` - No Orientation
* `1` - Solid Line
* `2` - Inferred Line

wall_strength.description:
ISRM strength of joint wall surface

* `R0` - R0 - Extremely Weak (<1 MPa)
* `R1` - R1 - Very Weak (1-5 MPa)
* `R2` - R2 - Weak (5-25 MPa)
* `R3` - R3 - Medium Strong (25-50 MPa)
* `R4` - R4 - Strong (50-100 MPa)
* `R5` - R5 - Very Strong (100-250 MPa)
* `R6` - R6 - Extremely Strong (>250 MPa)

feature_type.description: Legacy 2-letter code, derived on save from feature_type_fk when set. Retained for one release to enable trivial rollback; feature_type_fk is the source of truth.

dip.description: Dip in DEGREES from horizontal. ⚠️ NEGATIVE IS DOWNWARD: a vertical hole drilled straight down is -90, a horizontal hole is 0. On a collar it is the set-up inclination; on a survey station it is the measured inclination at that depth.

images.description: Attached records, each as an object carrying its id, its natural key and display metadata. Soft-deleted attachments are omitted.
